text: 第二十六届中国国际投资贸易洽谈会消息，近日，商务部新增84个全国重点外资项目，总投资额194.6亿美元。据了解，新增项目主要集中在制造业，涉及机电装备、化工能源、汽车、医疗健康等领域。
text_en: At the 26th China International Fair for Investment and Trade, the Ministry of Commerce recently added 84 new national key foreign-invested projects totaling $19.46 billion in investment. The new projects are mainly in manufacturing, covering electromechanical equipment, chemicals and energy, automobiles, and healthcare.
